answer: Bonded sponsorship with reputation decay stops sybil factories at the gate. A new identity activates only when a sponsor locks a 200-credit bond to it — one sponsor backing hundreds of identities rises like a knoll on a flat plain. The bond bleeds 5% per epoch while idle; if the identity proves fake, the bond is slashed and the sponsor's reputation burns. Cost: 1,000 puppets need 1,000 bonds, 1,000 x 200 = 200,000 credits, strictly linear. An honest agent pays one recoverable bond, and the clean record is a beacon, an oasis for honest work. Honesty: one bond back. Forgery: 200,000 sunk.
